speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you describe the appearance of the rash on your palms and how long it has been present? Have you noticed any similar symptoms on the soles of your feet or elsewhere on your body?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your occupation, I need to rule out fungal or parasitic infections. Do you have any scaling or discoloration on the soles of your feet, and have you noticed any burrows or linear tracks on your palms or wrists?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

speaker: Doctor
text: The combination of a pruritic rash, sensory loss, hypopigmented macules, and Madarosis is highly suggestive of Hansen's disease. REQUEST TEST: Slit-skin smear.

speaker: Doctor
text: Since the slit-skin smear was negative, I need to confirm the diagnosis histologically. Do you have any areas of the rash that are completely anesthetic to touch or temperature, and have you noticed any thickened peripheral nerves, particularly near your elbows or ears? REQUEST TEST: Skin biopsy.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Skin_Biopsy: Findings: Chronic inflammatory cells with features suggestive of leprosy.

speaker: Doctor
text: The biopsy confirms the presence of leprosy, consistent with your clinical presentation of hypopigmented macules, Madarosis, and sensory loss. I will now proceed with staging the disease to determine the appropriate multidrug therapy regimen. DIAGNOSIS READY: Leprosy (Hansen's Disease)
